craft_notes: Sthāyin: freed-name joy. Sanskrit first: three locative absolutes + kila + kathyate → L4 keeps the triple when, tradition-voice, naming. Rows: row 6 (kila kept — 'says the old word' IS the verse's tradition-voice). Rupture: dash after seed — conditions done, naming follows. Close: end-weight on indeed (freed indeed). Minimal pass: 'says the old word' for kila (tradition-voice sung). Read aloud: when/when/when — freed. Rejected: 'liberated' — killed: freed plain (mukta); 'it is said' passive — killed: old word speaks.

lines: Know your form, drop the veil, scatter striving's seed —
then, says the old word, you are freed indeed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prāpte svarūpavijñāne santyakte tattvakañcuke / udyogakāraṇe kīrṇe muktaḥ sa kila kathyate

reads_against.argmap: Own-form known, sheath cast, exertion scattered — he is called freed.
c1_essence: Form known, sheath cast, striving scattered: called freed.
